title: Detailed crown
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- crown base band -->
  <rect x="18" y="68" width="64" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="18" y="68" width="64" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <rect x="18" y="80" width="64" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D4A000"/>
  <!-- band jewels -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="76" r="4" fill="#FF3355"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="76" r="2" fill="#FF8899"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="76" r="4" fill="#33BBFF"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="76" r="2" fill="#99DDFF"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="76" r="4" fill="#44DD66"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="76" r="2" fill="#A0FFB0"/>
  <!-- left spike -->
  <polygon points="22,68 26,26 32,68" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <polygon points="26,26 29,40 32,68 22,68 26,26" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <polygon points="22,68 26,26 29,40 25,68" fill="#E8B800"/>
  <!-- left spike jewel -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="26" r="5" fill="#FF3355"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="26" r="3" fill="#FF8899"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- center spike (taller) -->
  <polygon points="44,68 50,14 56,68" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <polygon points="50,14 53,34 56,68 44,68 50,14" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <polygon points="44,68 50,14 53,34 47,68" fill="#E8B800"/>
  <!-- center spike jewel -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="6" fill="#33BBFF"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="4" fill="#99DDFF"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="15" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- right spike -->
  <polygon points="68,68 74,26 78,68" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <polygon points="74,26 77,40 78,68 68,68 74,26" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <polygon points="68,68 74,26 77,40 73,68" fill="#E8B800"/>
  <!-- right spike jewel -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="26" r="5" fill="#44DD66"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="26" r="3" fill="#A0FFB0"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="25" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- small side peaks -->
  <polygon points="32,68 36,42 40,68" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <polygon points="36,42 38,52 40,68 32,68 36,42" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <polygon points="32,68 36,42 38,52 34,68" fill="#D4A000"/>
  <polygon points="60,68 64,42 68,68" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <polygon points="64,42 66,52 68,68 60,68 64,42" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <polygon points="60,68 64,42 66,52 62,68" fill="#D4A000"/>
  <!-- tiny peaks between center and sides -->
  <polygon points="38,68 41,50 44,68" fill="#E8B800"/>
  <polygon points="41,50 42,58 44,68 38,68 41,50" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <polygon points="56,68 59,50 62,68" fill="#E8B800"/>
  <polygon points="59,50 60,58 62,68 56,68 59,50" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- extra small jewels on side peaks -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#FF3355"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="42" r="1.2" fill="#FF8899"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#FF3355"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="42" r="1.2" fill="#FF8899"/>
  <!-- decorative dots on band -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#FFF0A0"/>
  <!-- band bottom trim -->
  <rect x="18" y="81" width="64" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#C89B00"/>
</svg>
